items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: No, but he wrote a tune called 'My Weakness' and he played a solo on that that is one of the most beautiful solos I ever heard.

ctx.x: No, but he wrote a tune called 'My Weakness' and he played a solo on that that is one of the most beautiful solos I ever heard. There were two trumpet solos, one was muted followed by the open solo. I'm told the open solo was Ed Swayzee, and I asked Doc Cheatham if the muted solo was him, and he says he thinks it was.
Probably was. Doc Cheatham was in the band long before I was.
